nodes.html: Registering a new company involves lodging an application with ASIC, choosing a company name, appointing directors, issuing shares, and adopting a company constitution or replaceable rules. A registered accountant handles the ASIC company registration end-to-end, issues your ACN, and sets up the company tax file number (TFN) and Australian Business Number (ABN). Getting the share structure and officeholder appointments right at registration avoids costly amendments later.
nodes.text: Registering a new company involves lodging an application with ASIC, choosing a company name, appointing directors, issuing shares, and adopting a company constitution or replaceable rules. A registered accountant handles the ASIC company registration end-to-end, issues your ACN, and sets up the company tax file number (TFN) and Australian Business Number (ABN). Getting the share structure and officeholder appointments right at registration avoids costly amendments later.

nodes.html: ABN, GST and business name registration
nodes.text: ABN, GST and business name registration

nodes.html: An Australian Business Number (ABN) is required to operate a business, invoice correctly, and avoid withholding at the top marginal rate. GST registration is compulsory once your turnover reaches $75,000 (or $150,000 for ride-share/taxi). Registering a business name with ASIC protects your trading identity. Our matched accountants handle ABN registration, GST registration, PAYG withholding registration, and business name registration in the correct order so your business is properly set up from day one.

nodes.html: Setting up a trust requires a compliant trust deed, a trustee appointment, and an ABN and TFN for the trust. A partnership needs a partnership agreement, its own ABN and TFN. An SMSF must be established with a trust deed, trustee appointments, an ABN, TFN, and an election with the ATO — plus an independent auditor engaged each year. Our matched specialists prepare the documentation and complete every registration correctly so your structure is compliant from the outset.

nodes.html: Registration is only the first step. Companies must lodge annual review fees with ASIC, maintain a register of members, and notify ASIC of changes to officeholders or addresses. GST-registered businesses must lodge BAS (monthly or quarterly), and employers must register for STP2 and Payday Super. Our matched firms set up the ongoing compliance calendar so you never miss a deadline after registration.

nodes.q: How do I register a new company in Australia?
nodes.a: Registering a new company involves lodging an application with ASIC, choosing an available company name, appointing directors and shareholders, issuing shares, and adopting a constitution or replaceable rules. A registered accountant handles the full ASIC company registration, issues your ACN, and arranges the company TFN and ABN. Tell us in the questionnaire that you want to register a new company and we will match you with a firm that does it end-to-end.
nodes.aText: Registering a new company involves lodging an application with ASIC, choosing an available company name, appointing directors and shareholders, issuing shares, and adopting a constitution or replaceable rules. A registered accountant handles the full ASIC company registration, issues your ACN, and arranges the company TFN and ABN. Tell us in the questionnaire that you want to register a new company and we will match you with a firm that does it end-to-end.

nodes.q: Do I need an ABN and GST registration to start a business?
nodes.a: An ABN is required to operate a business, invoice correctly, and avoid no-ABN withholding at the top marginal rate. GST registration is compulsory once your turnover reaches $75,000 (or $150,000 for ride-share and taxi operators). Our matched accountants register your ABN and GST in the correct order so your business is properly set up from day one.
nodes.aText: An ABN is required to operate a business, invoice correctly, and avoid no-ABN withholding at the top marginal rate. GST registration is compulsory once your turnover reaches $75,000 (or $150,000 for ride-share and taxi operators). Our matched accountants register your ABN and GST in the correct order so your business is properly set up from day one.

nodes.q: What is the difference between a business name and a company?
nodes.a: A business name is a trading name registered with ASIC — it does not create a separate legal entity. A company is a separate legal entity registered with ASIC that can own assets, enter contracts, and limit liability. Our matched advisers help you decide which is right for you and handle either registration.
nodes.aText: A business name is a trading name registered with ASIC — it does not create a separate legal entity. Our matched advisers help you decide which is right for you and handle either registration.

nodes.q: Can a matched accountant register a trust or SMSF?
nodes.a: Yes. Setting up a trust requires a compliant trust deed, a trustee appointment, and an ABN and TFN for the trust. An SMSF must be established with a trust deed, trustee appointments, an ABN, TFN, and an ATO election — plus an independent auditor each year. Our matched specialists prepare the documentation and complete every registration correctly.
nodes.aText: Yes. Setting up a trust requires a compliant trust deed, a trustee appointment, and an ABN and TFN for the trust. An SMSF must be established with a trust deed, trustee appointments, an ABN, TFN, and an ATO election — plus an independent auditor each year. Our matched specialists prepare the documentation and complete every registration correctly.

nodes.q: How much does company registration cost?
nodes.a: ASIC charges a set fee for company registration, and accountants typically charge a setup fee on top that includes the ACN, company TFN, ABN, and share structure. The matched firm gives you a clear quote before any work begins — the matching service is free to you.
